# pve_node_config (Resource)

Node-specific configuration (ACME, description, wake-on-LAN, …) (singleton).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_config" "example" {
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `acme` (String) Node specific ACME settings.
- `acmedomain_n_` (String) ACME domain and validation plugin
- `ballooning_target` (Number) RAM usage target for ballooning (in percent of total memory) (default: 80)
- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `description` (String) Description for the Node. Shown in the web-interface node notes panel. This is saved as comment inside the configuration file.
- `location` (String) The location of the node. Overrides the default from the datacenter config.
- `startall_onboot_delay` (Number) Initial delay in seconds, before starting all the Virtual Guests with on-boot enabled. (default: 0)
- `wakeonlan` (String) Node specific wake on LAN settings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node (also the `terraform import` format).
